label: LHDN General e-Invoice Guideline v4.8
notes: Dates reflect the LHDN official guideline listing. This fixture is not a live-synced legal rules engine; verify source, version, effective date and legal applicability before using it for compliance decisions. This fixture uses RM3,000,000 as the currently published headline turnover reference for e-Invoice exemption screening; it does not make an automatic eligibility determination.

rules.title: e-Invoice exemption screening reference
rules.summary: LHDN's published implementation timeline lists taxpayers with annual turnover or revenue below RM3,000,000 as exempt from e-Invoice implementation. Verify the relevant turnover year, entity/ownership conditions, related-entity exceptions, and other applicable criteria against current official guidance before determining eligibility.
rules.reference: LHDN official implementation timeline and General Guideline v4.8; verify applicability against the current official source.

rules.title: RM10,000 transaction/consolidation review threshold
rules.summary: A RM10,000 threshold appears in specific e-Invoice/consolidation guidance contexts. It must not be applied as a universal legal mandate without checking the current specific guideline and transaction type.
rules.reference: Check General Guideline v4.8 and other applicable official provisions for the transaction type.

rules.title: Buyer TIN field validation
rules.summary: Check buyer TIN requirements against the current official guideline, transaction type and any applicable exceptions before deciding whether an invoice may be issued or consolidated.
rules.reference: LHDN General and Specific e-Invoice Guidelines; applicability must be verified.

rules.title: Human review for uncertain extraction
rules.summary: If the AI or built-in reader confidence is below 90%, require a person to review the extracted fields before approval. This is an Orbyte product safeguard, not a claim about a government-mandated confidence threshold.

rules.title: Budget 2027 corporate tax rate announcement scenario
rules.summary: Budget 2027 announced proposed preferential tax-rate changes. This fixture is a scenario only and must not be presented as enacted or in-force law without confirmation from the relevant Act, gazette, effective date and eligibility conditions.
rules.reference: MOF Budget 2027 speech; verify formal enactment and effective date.

rules.title: Budget 2027 minimum-wage announcement scenario
rules.summary: Budget 2027 announced a minimum-wage measure with an intended future effective date. Do not calculate guaranteed payroll savings or state an exemption until final official rules and eligibility conditions have been verified.
rules.reference: MOF Budget 2027 speech; verify formal rules and effective date.

rules.title: MediAsas first-year premium subsidy announcement
rules.summary: Budget 2027 announced a first-year premium subsidy of RM200 per eligible employee for SMEs with fewer than 75 employees, capped at 50 employees per company (maximum RM10,000). This is an announcement, not confirmed entitlement; verify the final programme rules and launch details.
rules.reference: MOF Budget 2027 speech; final programme details and eligibility must be verified.
